narrative.overview:
The page is a two-colour poster the club pulled by hand for the trip: uncoated near-black stock, one maize ink, and bone where the ink has been cleared so text can be read. Every surface is either stock or a solid block of ink; anything in between is a halftone of those two inks, never a third colour or a translucent tint. Paper grain sits over everything at low opacity, and the two ink slabs (the cover band under the hero art and the footer) have seeded rough-cut edges, so the page reads as an object rather than a screen.

Structure comes from printed rules, not boxes. Sections open on a condensed poster headline in maize, and content runs in open columns separated by solid maize ink rules (2-3px) between blocks and a halftone-dot rule between rows inside a list. The density is a run sheet: practical facts set plainly in a highly legible humanist sans, with the display face carrying the stoke in headings, day numerals, prices and step counters.

The build refuses the dark SaaS landing page: no rounded cards, no pill chips, no glass, no drop shadows, no smooth colour-to-colour gradients.
keyCharacteristics: Two inks on black stock; bone is cleared stock, not a third colour.
Ink rules and halftone-dot rules replace cards and borders.
Condensed poster display face, uppercase, weight 900; Atkinson Hyperlegible for reading.
Rough-cut SVG-masked edges on full-bleed ink slabs only.
Falling bone snow on a canvas behind content.

rules.name: The Two Inks Rule
rules.body: Maize and black stock are the only inks. Tints exist only as halftone dot patterns of one ink over the other (7px dot grid, 6px on progress tracks); never as opacity washes, smooth blends or new hues.

rules.name: The Knockout Rule
rules.body: Text on a maize block is always black stock; text on stock is bone, bone-dim, or maize. Bone never sits on maize.

rules.name: The Poster Face Rule
rules.body: The display face is always weight 900 and uppercase (numerals excepted), never used for running text.

rules.name: The Plain Facts Rule
rules.body: Times, prices, dates and deadlines in body copy are set in Atkinson at 700, not in a decorative treatment.

rules.name: The Flat Stock Rule
rules.body: Nothing floats. If a surface needs to stand out, it becomes a solid ink block or gets an ink rule; it never gets a shadow, blur or glow.

rules.name: The Rule Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Solid ink rule between sections and blocks; halftone-dot rule between rows inside a list. Never a full border box around a list row.

dos: Do keep every surface either black stock or solid maize ink; express in-between values as halftone dots.
Do separate sections and blocks with 2-3px solid maize rules, and rows inside a list with the halftone-dot rule.
Do set section headlines in Big Shoulders Display 900 uppercase in maize, and all reading text in Atkinson Hyperlegible.
Do swap inks on button hover (maize fill to stock fill with a maize keyline, or the reverse).
Do keep corners square (0px) on every element.
Do keep the snow canvas behind content so flakes never cross text.
donts: Don't introduce a third hue, a translucent tint, or a smooth colour-to-colour gradient (CSS gradients that draw halftone dots, rules and marks are the world's own tools and are fine).
Don't use rounded cards, pill chips, glass panels or drop shadows; the page is printed, not layered.
Don't use offset hard shadows on buttons; hover is an ink swap.
Don't put a decorative uppercase line above a section headline; headlines stand alone.
Don't apply the rough-cut edge to inner containers; it belongs to the full-bleed slabs only.
Don't set bone text on maize.
